# census-roadmaps.txt — FROZEN CORPUS: the 201 roadmap filenames that lived in
# docs/roadmaps/wip/ + docs/roadmaps/done/ of THIS repository on 2026-09-26, the day
# ML-3A replaced strings.Contains with the additive substring-OR-token-overlap matcher
# (ADR-2026-09-26-precisao-do-vinculo-branch-roadmap-escrever-em-vez-de-inferir.md).
#
# 🔴 WHY A FROZEN LIST AND NOT `ls docs/roadmaps/{wip,done}` AT GATE TIME:
# lesson of ML-7C of REQ-2026-08-31 — a corpus reachable only through a live query is a
# corpus the CI does not have. There the pre-fix objects survived in a SINGLE local ref,
# on a branch `trackfw branch prune --apply` would classify as "safe to delete". A gate
# whose population moves every time someone moves a roadmap does not pin a verdict: it
# reports today's weather. These 201 names never move again; regenerating them is a
# deliberate act, recorded in a roadmap, that MUST come with regenerated verdicts.
#
# Consumers: scripts/check-roadmap-slug-matching.sh materializes one empty .md per line
# into a synthetic project and runs `trackfw branch new --dry-run` against it. Only the
# FILENAMES matter to the matcher (MatchRoadmapsForBranchSlug reads names, never content),
# which is why no content is frozen here.
#
# Both wip/ and done/ are flattened into one list ON PURPOSE: the matcher unions wipDirs
# and doneDirs before scanning, so the split cannot change any verdict. Keeping the split
# would suggest it could.
#
# Format: one filename per line. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
